notes.title: Tower Build Queue, Sandbox
notes.content:
[h1]v0.2.0[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Added [b]Tower build queue[/b]. You can queue construction of towers one after the other. Imagine drawing a line on the map and queuing builds of towers along it quickly.
[*] Added manual pages to explain the game mechanics for the players who want to know the depths
[*] [b]Sandbox[/b] - Preliminary support for Level editor. Not completely functional yet, but that's coming soon too.
[/olist]
